description: Ministry of Roads and Highways - Declare that Outer Circular National Highway as an Expressway
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a legal order under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, designating a national highway as an expressway and revoking a previous order. It contains statutory instruments and regulatory changes related to transportation infrastructure, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the exercise of statutory powers to create regulatory changes.
